title: Share your location to use Vault
points: Vault sends your location to the administrator each time you open the app.
Only the latest location is kept. There is no history, and nothing is sent while the app is closed.
Other Vault users cannot see your location. You can see when the administrator last looked at it.
You can turn this off in the menu (⋮ → Location sharing), but Vault cannot be used while it is off.
